timid.name: Timid
timid.desc: Sticks close to you. Takes 15% less damage.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.desc: Enemies it defeats drop 50% more coin.

curious.name: Curious
curious.desc: Sniffs out hollow walls and secret rooms.

playful.name: Playful
playful.desc: Moves 15% faster and earns 20% more XP.

fungal.name: Mend
fungal.desc: Heals you 1.5 HP per second while it is near you.

tide.name: Undertow
tide.desc: Enemies it soaks are also slowed.

echo.name: Keen Ears
echo.desc: Hears hollow walls from twice as far.

gale.name: Tailwind
gale.desc: You move 8% faster while it fights beside you.

crystal.name: Facet Guard
crystal.desc: 10% chance to block a hit aimed at you.

warden.name: Bulwark
warden.desc: Enemies prefer to attack it over you.

venom.name: Lingering
venom.desc: Its poison lasts twice as long.

lumen.name: Beacon
lumen.desc: Its glare stuns for twice as long.

BOND_PERKS: Last Stand: survives one knockout per raid and unleashes its ability

regen.name: Regrowth
regen.desc: Heals 1.5% of max HP per second in raids

vamp.name: Leech Fang
vamp.desc: Heals 8% of the damage it deals

lucky.name: Lucky Charm
lucky.desc: +10% capture chance while in your party

twin.name: Twin Eggs
twin.desc: As a mother, 25% chance her clutch is two eggs

strongblood.name: Strong Blood
strongblood.desc: Passes its better stat allele 75% of the time

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.desc: Its shots bounce off walls once

thrifty.name: Thrifty
thrifty.desc: Eats no food on days it works in the hideout

artisan.name: Artisan
artisan.desc: Crafting quality +1.5 at its station; as foreman, for the whole station

tireless.name: Tireless
tireless.desc: Tires half as fast while working

text.before: Came with you from before the records began.
text.start: Was waiting for you at Ilsa’s hideout.
text.boss: Was there when {x} fell, and came home.
text.title: Earned the title {x}.
text.neardeath: Came home from {x} with almost nothing left.
